parsed.explanation: Combined regime: a criminal statute (Art. 354, 3 months to 2 years) reaches same-sex conduct, and a trans visitor read as same-sex falls within it. Enforcement is documented only pre-code (2013 arrests and a bar closure, sentences suspended on appeal). Police and prosecutors refuse to investigate crimes against LGBTQ+ people, and no anti-discrimination law exists. Official hostility is on record and social attitudes are hostile. No trans-specific border, facility, custody or care-exclusion rule is documented, and the dossier does not show document mismatches being enforced at entry. The imprisonment claim is uncorroborated and excluded. Net: documented recourse failure and hostility with a live criminal lever, placing the jurisdiction in the elevated-to-high band.

entry_documents.exposure: No pathway to amend sex markers; a visitor's home-issued documents cannot be aligned locally. No border enforcement of mismatches is documented.
entry_documents.interaction: Mismatch could prompt questioning if officers apply the criminal provision; the dossier does not show this occurring.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Same-sex conduct is criminalised; the 2013 arrests show the lever has been used. Civil-society claims of dozens held under other charges are uncorroborated and excluded.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Appeal suspended the 2013 sentences after community outcry, a single documented instance.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Criminal exposure combines with police refusal to protect, so a complainant may face the same system.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No facility, custody-placement or ward rules by birth sex are documented.

care_services.exposure: Discrimination and hostility when accessing healthcare are documented, affecting LGBTQ+ people generally.
care_services.protection: No formal care ban is documented.
care_services.interaction: Informal refusal could affect a visitor who needs care, though the dossier does not document it for visitors.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Former PM defended criminalisation on religious grounds; homosexuality is framed as a threat to family and a foreign invention. Official hostility is on record.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection for sexual orientation or gender identity.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat-framing from officials plus refusal to investigate leaves no institutional recourse.

minors_guardians.exposure: Art. 360 targets same-sex contact with minors. No trans-specific rule on travelling with a minor is documented. Adoption barriers are resident-facing.
minors_guardians.interaction: A trans adult travelling with a minor has no documented custody or facility rule; any same-sex reading risks the criminal provisions.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Police and prosecutors refuse to investigate crimes against LGBTQ+ people. Only Art. 350(i) addresses orientation-motivated rape, and its use is not stated.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Art. 350(i) provides 10 to 20 years for orientation-motivated rape, but its application is undocumented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Victims are unlikely to get state protection, and reporting may expose them to the criminal statute.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No functioning remedy is documented. Voter registration denial and housing and employment barriers are resident-facing.
remedies_unknowns.protection: No documented operative protection for visitors.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of recourse magnifies the criminal and hostility exposures.

anchor_checks.comparison: 0.35-A has a documented universal entry register and routine refusals. This dossier has no documented border exclusion, so it sits somewhat higher on entry, though its criminal statute and recourse failure are comparable.

0.25-D documents undercover entrapment and targeting of trans people. This dossier documents no trans-specific sweeps, so it rates similar or slightly higher, though its police non-protection is a comparable failure.
0.55-E documents uneven harassment with a working ombudsman. This dossier has a live criminal statute and documented refusal to investigate, with no anti-discrimination law, so it sits lower.

parsed.synthesis: The documented exposures are a criminal statute against same-sex conduct with a past enforcement example, official hostility, a refusal by police to investigate crimes against LGBTQ+ people, no anti-discrimination law, and healthcare hostility. The state's own non-protection means recourse is effectively absent. Entry, custody and facility rules for trans visitors are not documented and are treated as open questions, not as safety. Resident-facing items (adoption, voter registration, housing) are not scored. The result is an elevated-to-high risk profile.
